Pinned multilingual final-edge check on existing public FLEURS slices.

Uses the delivered bundled CLI, actual six-engine recognition within documented
language coverage, and an earlier frozen raw-score CLI as a range control. The
same fifty known clips are tested at original gain and -40 dB; this is not a new
holdout, real whispering, microphone acceptance or a latency comparison. Language hints are explicit. Parakeet excludes Hindi/Japanese/Mandarin; Cohere excludes Hindi before seeing outputs. All ASR is actual inference without output reuse. Every native range matches the earlier raw-score control with full PCM hashes. All references and hypotheses, including losses, remain in the archive. No default or model-promotion change; weights/cache and the delivered app signature are unchanged.
